name: Anonymous visitor sees a locked lab
description: Confirms the public URL never exposes the private AI workspace to anonymous visitors.
steps: Open Wormstar AI Lab in a fresh private browser session
Confirm the sign-in card is shown
Confirm the AI message composer is not available
expected: The visitor sees a sign-in prompt and cannot submit an AI request.

name: Non-owner account is denied access
description: Confirms that signing in is not enough to gain access without the configured owner email.
steps: Sign in using a test account whose email differs from WORMSTAR_OWNER_EMAIL
Choose Change account and verify the sign-in screen returns
expected: No private workspace or AI conversation is shown for a non-owner account.

name: Owner performs an AI analysis and exports the result
description: Confirms the configured owner can use the model and export a real visible answer.
steps: Sign in as the configured owner email
Paste a short intentionally insecure training snippet and submit it
Wait for an AI analysis to appear
expected: An AI review is rendered and a Markdown report downloads with the conversation.

name: IOC mode previews indicators and handles service failure on mobile
description: Confirms local IOC extraction and a visible failure message when the AI endpoint is unavailable.
steps: Sign in as the configured owner on a mobile viewport
Switch to Indicators of compromise mode
expected: The detected indicators appear locally and the simulated backend failure produces a visible retryable error.
